prompt: A bearded line cook with an undercut and a short top knot, both arms covered in full tattoo sleeves and a small fox tattoo on the side of his neck, wearing a black t-shirt and a stained kitchen apron, leaps across a steel kitchen prep table swinging a cast iron frying pan in one hand and holding a big steel serving fork in the other, frozen mid-air with a huge battle grin. A cartoon thug in a hoodie reels back with his face squashed in comic shock as the pan connects, and bold white comic knockout speed lines and a starburst explode from the hit, with plates and a flying roast chicken spinning through the air. A busy restaurant kitchen line fills the background under warm heat lamps. Bold comic illustration with thick black ink linework, sharp expressive faces and saturated colors of tomato red, teal and mustard yellow, with a plain empty strip of dark wall across the top quarter.
